data.name: Atlante
data.gender_notes: Atlante is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Atlante was a sea goddess who ruled over the Atlantis island. She was known for her great wisdom and magical powers, often depicted with a trident. The name Atlante carries the meaning “Atlantic goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atlante usually hope their child will grow to embody atlantic goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes depth, mystery, and connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Atlante belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Atlantic goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atlante total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אטלנטה
in_hebrew.meaning: אטלנטה: נושאת ההר אטלס, שומר גבולות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אטלנטה: נושאת ההר אטלס, שומר גבולות, מקור השם באטלס, אחד מהטיטאנים במיתולוגיה היוונית, אחראי על נשיאת השמים. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם עשוי לסמל כוחניות ויכולת נשיאה של עולמות.

in_greek.name: Ατλάντη
in_greek.meaning: Ατλάντη: η που φέρει τον Άτλαντα, φύλακας των συνόρων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ατλάντη: η που φέρει τον Άτλαντα, φύλακας των συνόρων, το όνομα προέρχεται από τον Άτλαντα, έναν από τους Τιτάνες της ελληνικής μυθολογίας, υπεύθυνο για τη στήριξη του ουρανού. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει δύναμη και ικανότητα στήριξης κόσμων.

in_latin.name: Atlante
in_latin.meaning: Atlante: quae fert Atlanten, custos finium
in_latin.long_meaning: Atlante: quae fert Atlanten, custos finium, nomen derivatum est ab Atlante, uno ex Titanibus in mythologia Graeca, qui caelum sustinet. In contextu christiano, nomen significare potest robur et mundorum sustentationem.

in_english.name: Atlante
in_english.meaning: Atlante: bearer of the sky, guardian of boundaries
in_english.long_meaning: Atlante: bearer of the sky, guardian of boundaries, derived from Atlas, one of the Titans in Greek mythology tasked with holding up the sky. In Christian context, the name may symbolize strength, endurance, and the ability to bear heavy responsibilities. Historically, the name Atlas has been associated with power and resilience.

data.cultural_impact: While not directly referenced in the Christian bible, the name "Atlante" can draw inspiration from Greek mythology, bringing a sense of connection to the rich cultural history of the ancient world and the captivating tales of gods and sea creatures. The name carries a legendary and mystical vibe which can add an intriguing dimension to anyone going by this name.
data.spiritual_significance: Although not based on Christian saints or religious figures, "Atlante" has spiritual significance by reminding us of the beauty, power, and mystery of the natural world as governed by the divine forces. It signifies a deep connection to the vast, boundless waters of the ocean, representing the fluidity and endlessness of life, and the depths of our own spiritual journeys. Much like how the Greek goddess Atlante was revered for her wisdom and magical abilities, the Christian name "Atlante" can serve as a reminder of the spiritual growth and wisdom we can achieve by tapping into the hidden depths within ourselves.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Atlante signifies the bearer's connection to the ancient wisdom and knowledge of the Atlantis civilization. It represents the pursuit of inner truth and the ability to balance spiritual and material realms.

biblical_reference.note: The name Atlante is not directly mentioned in the Bible but originates from Greek mythology.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Atlante was a legendary figure in the mythology of the ancient Greeks. The name Atlante carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Atlante was associated with the island of Atlantis and was said to have been the ruler of the island.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Atlante remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Sarah Atlante from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Atlante - "Atlantic goddess". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
